business_summary: Northrop Grumman Corporation is a major US defense prime (NYSE: NOC) spanning aeronautics, defense systems, space systems and mission systems, with in-house solid rocket motor, missile interceptor, ammunition and ammonium perchlorate oxidizer production.

exposure_summary.narrative: Northrop Grumman Corporation sits on 5 link(s) of the munitions-replenishment chain: Energetic materials: RDX, HMX, IMX formulations, TNT and nitrocellulose (position 2, EMERGING); Ammonium perchlorate and composite propellant oxidiser (position 3, EMERGING); Solid rocket motor production (position 7, CROWDED); Missile and interceptor final assembly (the primes) (position 10, OVER_CROWDED); Artillery and bulk munitions output (position 11, CROWDED). Uses and supplies energetic materials for munitions and rocket propulsion across its armament and propulsion businesses. Designs and produces medium and large class solid rocket motors for strategic missiles, missile defence interceptors and launch vehicles. Designs, integrates and produces large strategic missile systems and missile defence interceptors. Produces small, medium and large calibre ammunition. Operates an internal ammonium perchlorate production line established after 2016 AMPAC pricing changes, and became an approved alternative oxidizer source for space launch applications following 2021 qualification, making it a second producer alongside AMPAC/NewMarket. FY figures (period ended 2025-12-31): revenue $41,954,000,000 USD, operating margin 10.8%, 4.7% 3-year revenue CAGR.
